versions.changelog:
WiseDiag Report Skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Interpret medical report images and PDFs via local file upload or image URL
- Uses AI-powered OCR to recognize text, detect abnormal indicators, and provide health advice
- Supports binary (local file) uploads and image URLs (mutually exclusive per request)
- Requires a WISEDIAG_API_KEY environment variable for authentication
- Provides privacy notice and strong disclaimer: data sent to WiseDiag servers and not a substitute for medical advice
